mapper.select: SELECT id, hero_title, intro_title, banner_images, hero_subtitles, author_display_name, author_motto, author_avatar FROM home_hero_settings WHERE id = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO home_hero_settings (id, hero_title, intro_title, banner_images, hero_subtitles, author_display_name, author_motto, author_avatar) VALUES (1, #{row.heroTitle}, #{row.introTitle}, #{row.bannerImagesJson}, #{row.heroSubtitlesJson}, #{row.authorDisplayName}, #{row.authorMotto}, #{row.authorAvatar}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE hero_title = VALUES(hero_title), intro_title = VALUES(intro_title), banner_images = VALUES(banner_images), hero_subtitles = VALUES(hero_subtitles), author_display_name = VALUES(author_display_name), author_motto = VALUES(author_motto), author_avatar = VALUES(author_avatar)
